set.body: Forward-review P1 against ADR 0001 D2. identity.scala:310-328 documents compatibility as the same late-pooling recipe but validates only latePooling.matryoshkaDimension. Executable repro: query recipe (tok-a, window128/stride64, mean, PartialCoverage) and document recipe (tok-b, window64/stride32, max, Missing) under the same provider/dimension/norm/truncation return Right(GeometryPair). RemotePolicy.evaluate also copies request.space without proving it belongs to the authorized provider/model. Acceptance: define an explicit compatibility key/policy distinguishing coordinate compatibility from modelling-choice differences; validate every field that policy declares geometric; bind remote capability to a provider-owned space; property-mutate each compatibility field and require rejection unless explicitly declared compatible; preserve intentionally asymmetric query/document views with a named rule.
set.title: P1 embed identity: make GeometryPair and remote-space compatibility explicit
